attorneys: Henry J. Friendly for petitioners in No. 4., E. Smythe Cambrell for petitioner in No. 5., John T. Cahill and Fred J. Knauer for W. R. Grace & Co., and W. F. Cogswell and H. Preston Morris for the Pan American-Grace Airways, Inc., respondents.
